attchmntText: S&S Power Switchgears Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: S&S Power Switchgear Limited filed an investor presentation update for the second quarter of the fiscal year ending 2027. The filing was submitted to the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd on the 14th of November 2026. The presentation details the company's performance metrics for the year to date and the second quarter. Reported figures include new orders of 14,597 lakhs and revenue of 14,544 lakhs. The earnings before interest, depreciation, and amortization stood at 632 lakhs. The earnings per share recorded a value of negative 2.18. The document outlines a three-year strategic plan targeting revenue doubling by the fiscal year 2028. It also highlights capacity expansion and international market entry initiatives.

attchmntText: S&S Power Switchgears Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms Durv and Associates LLP as Other of the company w.e.f. November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: S&S Power Switchgear Limited reported un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 13th November 2026. The company recorded a net loss of 123.0 Lakhs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to a net profit of 76.6 Lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the net loss was 101.2 Lakhs, versus a net profit of 62.7 Lakhs in the previous year. Total revenue from operations stood at 106.12 Lakhs for the quarter and 212.25 Lakhs for the half year. The Board also appointed M/s. Durv and Associates LLP as the Internal Auditor for the Financial Year 2026-27, effective 13th November 2026. A limited review report was issued by Statutory Auditor M/s. CNK & Associates LLP.
